# otel-span-lint

Lint OpenTelemetry spans from OTLP JSON against HTTP semantic conventions v1.26.0. Dependency-free, Python >= 3.10.

## Core API

- `otel_span_lint.lint_document()`
- `otel_span_lint.lint_file()`
- `otel_span_lint.Finding`
- `otel_span_lint.RuleTable`
